title: One Runtime for User Entry Points

implementation_changes.description: Added ChatRuntime protocol definition and runtime injection; routes generate_response and stream_response through runtime.process_direct when bound.
Refactored chat endpoints to use ChatService via FastAPI dependency injection, supporting unified runtime routing and versioned raw_completion parameter.

coverage_areas: API synchronous chat routing to runtime.process_direct
API SSE streaming with token and done frames
Execution parity across API, CLI, and Dashboard
